news.headline: Here's How Much $100 Invested In Coherent 10 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today
news.summary: Coherent (NYSE:COHR) has outperformed the market over the past 10 years by 9.22% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 22.35%. Currently, Coherent has a market capitalization of $44.35 billion.
